literal_meaning: সহচর শব্দ (reduplicative playful sound word indicating light-hearted nonsense)
figurative_meaning_bn: ইয়ারকি, ফাজলামি; রঙ্গরস; লঘু হাস্য-পরিহাস; হাসিতামাশা হাসিঠাট্টা
figurative_meaning_en: joking around, tomfoolery; humor; light-hearted banter; fun and frolic
example_sentences_in_english: The friends are passing time with some tomfoolery.
Sounds of fun and frolic can be heard in the neighborhood.
note: This is a typical Bengali reduplicative expression used in informal settings to denote light-hearted mischief.
